primary_dataset.title: Shallow whole genome sequencing
primary_dataset.description: This dataset contains a collection of tumour samples from high grade serous ovarian carcinoma patients with recurrent disease collected near the point of diagnosis as well as tumour samples collected after patient relapse upon or some time after study entry. The majority of diagnosis samples were preserved in neutral buffered formalin whereas the majority of post-relapse samples were preserved in universal molecular fixative (UMFIX, Sakura Finetek USA, Inc). DNA was extracted and whole genome sequencing libraries were prepared either using the TruSeq DNA Nano kit (Illumina) or the ThruPLEX DNA-Seq Kit (Takara Bio), which were respectively sequenced  at low depth (~0.1-0.5X) on illumina HiSeq 2500 and HiSeq 4000 sequencing platforms. Sequenced reads were aligned to the GRCh37 reference genome (release hs37d5).

pairing_schema_sig7_serialSAE.goal: pair diagnosis (pre-treatment) vs relapse (post-platinum) tumour samples per patient
pairing_schema_sig7_serialSAE.join_key: EGA sample/subject id via /datasets/{ds}/samples (sample metadata carries case + timepoint)
pairing_schema_sig7_serialSAE.sig7_inputs: shallow-WGS BAM/relative-CN -> copy-number signatures (Macintyre 2018 / BriTROC CN signatures); Sig7 = one CN signature component
pairing_schema_sig7_serialSAE.serial_sae_inputs: paired pre/post BAMs for the same patient -> serial structural/CN alteration events (SAE) tracking acquired resistance
pairing_schema_sig7_serialSAE.endpoint: true acquired platinum resistance (relapse after platinum) — the real-resistance endpoint

alternates.enables: primary HGSOC WGS somatic + CN signatures; some primary-resistance annotation
